title: FLAVOURKIZZ KIZOMBA FESTIVAL 2026
description:
💥 Last year was absolutely amazing__full of love, music, and unforgettable vibes!
It was pure magic… and this year, we’re doing it all over again__together! 💃🏽🕺🏽
❤️‍🔥 FlavourKizz Kizomba Festival 2026 ❤️‍🔥
Let’s go and taste the FLAVOUR… 🍭🍭
Because once you feel it__you’ll never forget it!
It’s more than just a dance__ it’s a whole vibe.
📍 November 12–15, 2026 | Event Center Fokker, Hoofddorp (NL)
⸻
✨ What to Expect
✅ 1 Epic Pre-Party (Included in Full Pass)
✅ 4 Days of Workshops
✅ 3 Days of Social Dancing
✅ 4 Unforgettable Party Nights
✅ 2 Beautiful Dance Rooms ❤️‍🔥
✅ Fully Airconditioned Venue & FREE Parking 🅿️
✅ FREE Hotel Shuttle Bus (4-min ride) 🚌
⸻
💃🏽 2 Floors – 2 Vibes 🕺🏽
